sources.title: Distributed Systems
sources.edition: 4th edition, 2023; official catalogue lists version 4.03 released January 2025
sources.actual_read_scope: Official catalogue and personalized-copy form; no book chapters.

sources.adoption: Candidate for later chapter research; no technical guidance adopted from an unread book.

sources.title: Understanding Distributed Systems
sources.author: Roberto Vitillo
sources.edition: Second edition, as identified in the observed sample's preface; exact digital revision not exposed in the read edition statement
sources.actual_read_scope: Complete chapter 1 Introduction, printed pages 1–9 (PDF page indices 18–26, zero-based), plus preface edition statement. A few later passages were returned by the reader but are not counted as complete chapter readings. Figures not visually inspected.
sources.adoption: Coverage check for architecture, communication, useful throughput and maintainability; no new runtime advice.

sources.title: Patterns of Distributed Systems
sources.author: Unmesh Joshi
sources.edition: Official sample copyright 2024; ISBN 9780138221980; editor catalogue lists release in 2023
sources.actual_read_scope: Complete chapter 1 The Promise and Perils of Distributed Systems, printed pages 3–11 (PDF page indices 29–37, zero-based). Later chapter excerpts not counted as complete readings. Figures not visually inspected.
sources.adoption: Worked-example arithmetic checked independently; historical failure counts and deployment commands not promoted to current defaults.

sources.title: Distributed systems for fun and profit
sources.author: Mikito Takada
sources.edition: Author introduction dated 2013; public web text observed 2026-10-01
sources.actual_read_scope: Complete substantive chapter 5 Replication: weak consistency model protocols, including text diagrams and tables. Other chapters not read in this batch.
sources.adoption: Led to separate primary CALM and invariant-confluence author readings. Historical database defaults remain unverified and are not adopted.

arithmetic.model: 1000 independent equal-probability daily Bernoulli failure trials with p=0.001
arithmetic.limits: Independent trials are an explicit additional model assumption; no real fleet probability inferred.
